placements.overview:
Established in 2001, Asia Pacific Institute of Management is a private institute in Panipat, Haryana. The institute is approved by the AICTE. At the UG and PG levels, the institute offers 11 courses across 5 specialisations in Full Time mode. The popular Asia Pacific Institute of Management programs include B.E. / B.Tech, MBA/PGDM and BBA. Asia Pacific Institute of Management courses are provided in several streams including Engineering and Business & Management Studies, etc. The institute has a total seat intake of 300 students. The fees at Asia Pacific Institute of Management ranges between INR 1,60,000 to 3,13,200 for the different courses. The institute has a well-laid infrastructure with multiple facilities.

Asia Pacific Institute of Management offers diverse programmes at UG and PG levels in Full Time mode. The offered programmes can be chosen from streams such as Engineering and Business & Management Studies. At the UG level, candidates have the provision to opt from courses such as B.E. / B.Tech and BBA. Whereas, at PG level, Asia Pacific Institute of Management offers courses such as MBA/PGDM. Asia Pacific Institute of Management fee structure for all the courses is around INR 1,60,000 to 3,13,200.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied with the facilities.

review_content.Placements: In our batch, there are 66 students. The highest package offered was INR 2.5 lakh. Many companies come there, just like Airtel and Solitaire. Many students got jobs. We prefer that you not come to this college because the faculty and staff are not so good and are not showing proper interest in most things.
review_content.Infrastructure: No wi-fi, but computer labs are there, classrooms are average, and the library provides books. There are no medical facilities in the hostel, and the food is also average. No proper sports and games facilities are there. We prefer that you not come to this college because you have to face many problems there.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: I am pursuing BBA from this college. I am fully satisfied with our college.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are quite good compared to other colleges. The salary package offered ranges from 4.5 LPA-15 LPA. Many companies visit our college and offer salary packages to students and make them achieve their goals of life. Many students who are passed out from this college are living a good life.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is better than other colleges. Smart classrooms are available with Wi-Fi facility. The library has different books from different authors. Medicine, water and other equipment are always available without shortage. Transportation facilities are also provided.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: All the faculty members are good with the good teaching style, and all teachers have a unique style.

review_content.Placements: Almost more than 95% of students got placed last year. The highest salary package offered was 15 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 4.5 LPA. Companies like, Nestle, ICICI Bank, Bandhan Bank, Byju's, Jaro, ITC, Jaguar, S&P Global and many more companies visited our campus for placements. Roles like financial analyst, area manager, business development manager, HR manager, marketing manager, etc., were offered to students. The average salary package offered was 6.5 LPA. Almost 100% of student get an internship in companies like ITC, Jaro, Jmarathon Advisory Services Ltd, Aditya Birla Sun Life, Mutual Fund, Hitachi, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: A good business school in Delhi-NCR region.

review_content.Placements: I am currently doing my internship, and the companies that offered internship opportunities were quite decent. Some of the major companies like Aditya Birla Capital, 360 Realtors, and Hindustan Wellness visited the campus to offer internships. However, most of the opportunities were given for marketing students, but they also provided good opportunities for finance students too. The placements of our senior batch were good. Around 70 companies visited the campus to offer placement opportunities, and the major recruiters were ICICI Bank and IndusInd Bank.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2017
reviews_list.review_title: My 4 years of life in Asia Pacific Institute of Information technology is the best.

review_content.Placements: There was a good placement team, and it invites top MNCs. They taught us how to present ourselves in the campus placement. Companies visit the campus regularly to offer placements, and it is a great advantage of our college. The average salary offered in our college was 5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was good with spacious classrooms and air conditioner facilities. There was a wide range of flora and fauna inside our campus. Swans and peacocks were centres of attraction of our campus. There was Wi-Fi facility available throughout the campus. The library was highly enriched with books, magazines and novels.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: A great college for mechatronics engineering.

review_content.Placements: I have visited the college and got to know from students studying there that in 2014-18 batch, almost all the eligible students have got placements. There are great opportunities for mechatronics students. Companies that have visited the campus recently are Arabol Lubricants, Kaps Group, Duratuff Glass, Trigent, E2E, etc. Students are allowed to be volunteers for the placement drives, and junior students can get an exposure of managing such events as well as they can learn how to appear in the interview and about the interview procedures. Since they manage all activities under the guidance of faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: The college has the good infrastructure and facilities. Till 2016, the placements are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Out seniors were placed in a well known companies. Around 60% of students are joining to job every year. Companies like Byjus, cocubes are still more regular visitors. For a new passed out student, it may be difficult to find the job individually. Whereas placements in colleges helps in this criteria.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides you facilities like Wi-Fi, transportation, academic circular activities. All classroom are well equipped with projectors. A quality in food and hygiene canteen is well maintained. Seperate hostel for boys and girls is provided at an reasonable fare.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Sapthagiri is a worthy college.

content.Placements: Our college has placements from all around the world. The best ones are Microsoft, Mind tree, Infosys, etc. The highest salary offered was around 4.50 lacs per annum and the minimum was around Rs. 75,000 per annum. Most of the posts were for workers and assistants. Overall, the placements were good.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Sapthagiri is very wide with gardens and libraries both digital and normal. The classrooms accommodate 70 students, and there are other facilities like labs for all subjects, sports room, medical room, etc. There is a canteen and stationery shop inside the campus for students and teachers.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Good college for people looking to get placed at the end of 4 years.

content.Placements: Good placements happen every year. Companies like Amazon visit the campus every year, thanks to the placement team of sapthagiri college of engineering. Many startups also visit the campus on a regular basis. Big companies like TCS and Infosys have also visited the campus.
content.Infrastructure: Brilliant infrastructure is provided. The labs are very well-equipped. There is an amphibian theatre. And it has a lush or greenery all over the campus. The conference room is also well-equipped with good seating arrangement and speakers. Classrooms are also well organised.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: My Dream college for becoming a Graphical designer, Game programming and designing.

content.Placements: Good. Some got in Microsoft. Some got at Infosys. Some were not so lucky. The percentage of the students that were placed was 87 percent. The highest salary offered was 5 Lacs per annum. The post that was offered for the highest salary was MD. The percentage of internship was 52 percent. The highest and the lowest salary offered for internship was 50k and 70k per annum. There is a placement cell in our college.
content.Infrastructure: It has library as well as digital library. College infrastructure is so big that it got 2 playgrounds. 1 big park and many places to sit. It also contains shop for purchases inside the college. Digital classes, Wi-Fi labs and there are 3 hostel for boys and 2 for girls.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Joining this college is the good decision ever.

content.Placements: The college provides good placements. Many companies come to our college. Many students are getting placed in good companies. This college is absolutely brilliant and marvellous. Many companies like Infosys BYJUs, Indian Armed Forces, Air Force, Navy and many more come to our college.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is the best. It's really good. The classrooms are very well-equipped with a projector and good benches. The classrooms are large, and the lectures are audible to everyone. There are good labs with well-equipped equipment. The sports rooms are very good.

review_summary.college_name: Sant Baba Bhag Singh University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I do not recommend this college to others.

content.Placements: In our course, 50% or a few students get placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course is around 4 LPA and the average package offered in our course ranges from 1-2 LPA or less. The top roles offered in our course are web developer, full stack developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our university is very bad as well as the management. Wi-Fi is present in our university and hostel but it's very slow and barely works. Labs are present in our university but a majority of computers do not work and others are very slow.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sant Baba Bhag Singh University, Jalandhar, is good.

content.Placements: Around 70–80% of students are placed, with the highest package of 10 LPA, the lowest 3 LPA, and an average of 4.5 LPA. The top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Capgemini. 60% of students secured internships at companies like Cognizant, HCL, and startups, mainly in roles such as software developer, analyst, and QA engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The college offers well-equipped labs, Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, and a decent library. Facilities support practical learning, though some equipment may be outdated. The hostel rooms are basic but livable, with average food in the mess. Medical help is available on campus, and the college has good sports facilities for both indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This university is great.

content.Placements: More than 60% of the students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course is 2 - 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Shopping Minds, Solitaire Infosis, Teach Cadd, etc. Almost 80% of the students got the internship.
content.Infrastructure: In our university, the infrastructure is great and facilities are available for all the students and teachers, but hostel services and facilities are not that great. The hostel food is very basic and the same items are repeated every week. All types of sports and games are available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Hotel Management and Catering Technology (BHMCT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A hostel is not recommended.

content.Placements: More than 70% of students got placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course ranges from 2-3 LPA and the average package offered in our course ranges from 1-1.5 LPA. The top roles offered in our course are chief, bartender, serviceman, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is average. Facilities like Wi-Fi, library, and well-settled classrooms are also present for students. The infrastructure of our hostel is not that great, and it is below average. The food is not good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Hotel Management and Catering Technology (BHMCT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A hostel is not recommended.

content.Placements: In our course more than 80 percent of the students secure placements. The highest package offered is about 2-3 LPA and the average package is approximately 1-1.5 LPA. Top recruiting hotels include The Park Hotel (New Delhi) The Sunday Hotel (Chandigarh) and others.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is average with facilities such as WiFi a library, and well-equipped classrooms available for all students. However, the hostel infrastructure is below average, and the food quality is also lacking.

paragraphs: Sant Baba Bhag Singh University admissionsare primarily merit-based. The university conducts an entrance exam for PhD programme.Sant Baba Bhag Singh Universityoffers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in multiple streams such as Engineering, Law, Humanities, Science, etc. The university offers these courses through 14 departments. SBBS University admissions are conducted both in online and offline mode. Candidates need first choose the course of their choice and fulfil its selection and eligibility requirements for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in Sant Baba Bhag Singh University:
STEP 1: SBBS University Application Process 2025

Candidates can get the prospectus and application form from the university campus or apply online on the official website of SBBS. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 1,000 via DD for offline submissions.
STEP 2: Selection
Applicants are shortlisted for all UG and PG programmes based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. The university conducts an entrance exam for admission to PhD programme.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation

Once the selection process is over, admission team of the university sends a confirmation mail to the selected candidates. Such aspirants will need to pay the requisite fee to confirm their seat in the university.

The university conducts KKMU Admission Test to shortlist candidates for specific courses. KKMU offers courses, such as BTech (CS) certification, BBA, MCA, MBA, MTech etc., at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the university also offers doctorate, diploma and PG diploma courses. To get admission to KK Modi University, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. The university offers more than 15 courses (including specialisations) in various streams such as Engineering, Design, Management, Commerce etc. The application process at KK Modi University is conducted online.

admission_process.title: KK Modi University Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: KK Modi University admission processincludes registration and candidates need to sit and appear for the entrance exam as per respective courses. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat at KK Modi University:
STEP 1: KK Modi University Application Process

Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the institute. Aspirants can also visit the admission cell to apply for the desired course at KK Modi University. Candidates need to pay INR 380 to apply for a course.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds & Provisional Admission

Students are selected based on an entrance exam, GDPI. However, candidates also have to pay an application fee as per respective courses. If selected, admission are offered provisionally, and the applicant needs to deposit an amount of INR 10,000 through DD/Online.
STEP 3:Admission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, aspirants need to report at the campus and pay theKK Modi University feesto confirm their seat.

reviews.review_heading: A review from a student.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is hi-tech and totally updated with safety checks. The college environment is too friendly. I don't have any experience of hostel life. For the sports and games, we have pool table, table tennis, volleyball field, badminton field, and many things are under construction.

reviews.review_heading: KKMU life and overview.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our university is very good compared to the other colleges. Only from a distance we can see the difference between our university and other colleges regarding infrastructure. All the things are there like Wi-Fi, tables, cafeteria, sports, games, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: The thing that summarizes my college review would be the college like never before.
reviews.review_text: In our college, we had great and wonderful infrastructure. Wi-Fi was available, and we had a dedicated life for computer students. We had a classroom suitable for students up to 30. There was a library and tables were installed over there.

reviews.review_heading: A Day in My College Life.
reviews.review_text: The hostels provided by our college are very clean and hygienic and the location is very good. As all the other shops are easily accessible from that location and it’s safe. Measures and canteen facilities are also available for sports and games. The quality of the food is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is pretty good and comfortable too and also the arrangements are good. We receive good facilities but we have food issues because mess food is not that good. Also, we face several issues with food. The canteen is good and also we have the pool, carrom, TT, and many types of games available.

reviews.review_heading: My College Days and About My Life.
reviews.review_text: We have facilities in college, such as IT labs and a library. We even have a stage for our events. We also celebrate events like Durga Pooja, Diwali, Christmas and many more. We also celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi and many more events. We also perform in our events, like dance, music, and instrumental plays.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KK Modi University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a library, Wi-Fi, classrooms, etc. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners. Computer labs have advanced computers. We can perform hands-on experiments and implementation of studied concepts. The hostel facility is available in our college. The bus facility is available for hostlers.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KK Modi University.
reviews.review_text: We have IT labs and research labs which help us to grow further. We have a library where every book is available. We can borrow books from the library.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college and placement .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure: Our college has a library, Wi-Fi, classrooms, etc. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditions. Computer labs have advanced computers. We can perform hands-on experiments and implementation of studied concepts. The hostel facility is available in our college. The bus facility is available for hostlers.

reviews.review_heading: My point of view about kk Modi university and the experience I had.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are really good at their work they pay attention to each and every student in class clear doubt and help them to explore their believe. Sports events game are really attractive and impressive send of are university. Medical faculty is also good at kkmu.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Chhattisgarh has very good infrastructure our college which makes this pure college different from the other colleges. There is Wi-Fi-enabled campus and digital library in which we can take all the resources. Lab is also very high tech which we never noticed in the study.

reviews.review_heading:
"KK Modi University: A Modern Campus with Practical Learning and Global Opportunities"
.
reviews.review_text: KK Modi University offers a modern 25-acre campus with air-conditioned smart classrooms, a well-stocked library, and advanced labs. It has separate hostels for boys and girls, a cafeteria, sports facilities, and medical services. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled and provides transport services, recreation areas, and student clubs for overall development.

reviews.review_heading: Great Infrastructure and Faculty and career ready for future setting .
reviews.review_text: The faculty members and infrastructure available for this course are computer lab, wi-fi, classroom, library, cafeteria, garden and gurukul. Spacious Atrium, comfortable sitting and games and also tables for having lunch and in addition classroom are like working place in offices.

reviews.review_heading: Many option are there.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi not working properly 
No labs
Classroom is okay but the classroom temperature always hot and just said that we will provide you AC classroom? No sports facilities, No message or Canteen, No games facilities and the room rent is very high, this room does not deserve that much rent.

reviews.review_heading: The best college near Durg Bilahi and Rajnandgaon.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is fabulous, fully furnished with centralized AC and smart classes with three-sided glass walls, surrounded by greenery. It has a basketball play area, and indoors, they have a pool table and table tennis. They don't have a hostel yet, but it is soon to be available. individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The VHNSN- An honest review.

content.Placements: Nearly 80% of students are placed every year. The highest package is 5.6 LPA, and the lowest salary is 2.5 LPA. TMB is the top recruitment company we have seen. 75% of students got internships from my course in several companies like Aavin, Idhyam Parikshan Lab, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Enough facilities and infrastructure to deal with our course. We have Wi-Fi and labs. Classrooms are very neat and spacious. We have department library and a general library too which is too huge. Canteen is very good and food is hygienic in both canteen and hostel.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am very excited to share the best college of my life.

content.Placements: I am currently studying in the 2023-2025 batch of M.Sc. Microbiology, with 25 students in our batch. The master of business administration is the highest-value course, and chemistry is the lowest-value course offered. TMB is the top recruitment company in our entire college. 95% of students secure internships, and 75% of students are placed in Sureti company. Senior lab associate is the top role.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities in the hostel are well good, and the department provides us with a clean and healthy environment with great hospitality. review_summary.college_name: Saroj International University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Saroj International University is best management college in North India.

content.Placements: 89% of students were placed in the last academic year. The highest package was 18 LPA, and the lowest was 3.5 LPA. The average package was 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, Coca-Cola, Flipkart, Microsoft, and Amazon. 90% of students got internships in reputed companies. The top roles offered are Assistant Manager, HR and Quality Control Head.
content.Infrastructure: The college has smart classrooms with AC facilities, Wi-Fi and a smart board. The college has a library with more than 18000 books. The hostel facility is good for girls and proper hygiene is maintained in the mess. Here we can get a variety of foods, including north indian & south indian food in the mess and canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Saroj International University is the best college in Northern India.

content.Placements: More than 90% of students got placed. The highest package is 18 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA, with an average package of 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, HCL, and Tata. 100% of students got internships in local and reputed companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The college provides air-conditioners in all classrooms. It also offers Wi-Fi, computer labs, smart classrooms, and a well-equipped library with 27000 books. The hostel facilities are very good. The quality of food is very tasty. The canteen and mess provides north Indian as well as South Indian foods. The college has an in-house medical facility, sports grounds and equipment.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharma) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best college with best facilities.

content.Placements: Placements are quite active. We try to get companies from all domains for students and have a good placement record between 4-6 LPA, with placements around 50-60%. Many reputed companies come to college, and training is provided by the placement cell with certain exams.
content.Infrastructure: The college campus size is fine. We have all facilities inside the campus, including AC rooms, library, canteen, and sports ground, which is famous in the whole university. The college has greenery with good drinking water facilities, and the campus is totally Wi-Fi enabled. The campus is clean and green with modern classrooms, updated labs, and decent hostels. The library is excellent, and good facilities are provided.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharma) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and supportive faculty members.

content.Placements: Best college with its placements. Companies come to the college and directly place students in different sectors with good packages. The placement process usually involves registration, presentation, written test, and interviews. The college has a placement cell where training is provided. The placement head gives training to help us achieve our goals and is very supportive in every way. Many students are placed even in the 3rd year of B.Pharma and in the 2nd year of D.Pharma in different reputed pharmaceutical companies.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a good building with many facilities like drinking water, AC classrooms, smartboards, comfortable seating, projectors, Wi-Fi, and a spacious library with computer facilities. It also has a well-established canteen. The college campus has a good hostel facility with separate for boys and girls. The hostel provides good lodging and food, along with medical facilities if required. The college has a large playground where students can play outdoor games. The hostel mess provides proper lunch. The quality of food is good and hygienic. It has a different menu each day.

reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar so I don't know about the hostel facilities but the overall facilities that are provided to the students are Wi-Fi, computer lab, digital library, multipurpose hall, gym, library and many other facilities Their are events held for sports.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied because of the good faculty, placements, and experience offered in our college.
reviews.review_text: I'm a student of DHM and I have studied at IFTM University. It has top classes, good labs, and a good library. All facilities are very good and other qualities are very good, like a good canteen and a good playground. There are 80 buses available for transportation to students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Business Management, IFTM University.
reviews.review_text: In this college, the hostel and mess are good. They provide good food to the students and good facilities in the room. The canteen is also good and there are different types of beverages available for students. Thanks to this college for these facilities which made our college life good.

reviews.review_heading: There are no placements. Teachers are average qualified, and infrastructure is also average.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was good, and Wi-Fi is available on the campus. The hostel fee is reasonable, and the mess provides good food. Medical facilities are also available on the campus. Sports functions are conducted every year, and other activities and programmes are also conducted from time to time.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Business Management, IFTM University.
reviews.review_text: In our university, they provide various courses for students. I am a student in the business management department. In our department, there are various courses with more space. In every classroom, there are 2 air-conditioned facility and 6 fans with space for 150 students. In the hostel, all services are very good. Our hostel is the best.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with good infrastructure and good teachers.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, and the facilities are also good. There are proper labs and good facilities like that kitchen lab, restaurant and housekeeping lab. The library is also available. Good quality facilities are provided in the hostel. The mess food is good, and the gym and sports facilities are also available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It is a college teaching the students the ability to earn rather than giving lucrative packages.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided here is excellent by charging a nominal fee. The library has a wide range of books from the international authors. The medical facilities are provided for free to every student. The classrooms have an immense space for the gatherings. I didn't find anything different or silly regarding the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty of this college are excellent, and it's a good college for the purpose of learning.
reviews.review_text: The library and the classrooms of this college are good. They also provide Wi-Fi facility in every lab and department. They also give priority to sports and games by providing all the sports material and grounds and also an indoor stadium for playing indoor games. The food quality in the canteens is good. The hostel rooms are good. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. I never faced any type of infrastructure related issues during my tenure at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Overall it is a quite good college for the learning purpose.
reviews.review_text: WI-Fi is available only in labs and there are two auditorium in every department and there is lot of priority given to sports as cricket, basketball, football & many other indoor games have their different grounds. The food provided in the hostel & canteen is edible to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Other than the placement for BBA, I am happy with this college and might suggest to my friends.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite impressive. It attracts many students by its infrastructure and the kind of facilities which they have in their university or college. The college has a well-developed library, auditorium and seminar halls where all the important events take place.

Jyothishmathi Institute of Technology and Science TS EAMCET cutoff 2025 was concluded with the release of the final cutoff list. The cutoff was released as opening and closing ranks for the AI and HS quota. In the General category under the HS quota, the last round closing ranks ranged between 41207 and 88662 for B.E. / B.Tech admission. B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering was the toughest to get admission into, considering its competitive cutoff rank. For other B.E. / B.Tech speci

For B.E. / B.Tech admission, the top three most competitive branches were B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning), with competitive TS EAMCET last round cutoff ranks of 41207, 75107 and 80661, respectively. These ranks are valid for the students belonging to the General HS quota.

For 2026 admission, candidates can refer to the table below to view some of the important TS EAMCET dates. TS EAMCET is a state-level entrance test for admission to BE, B.Tech, BPharm, PharmD, B.Sc, B.FSc, and BVSc courses.

The TS EAMCET cutoff has been released for admission to Jyothishmathi Institute of Technology and Science. Candidates can view or download the consolidated year-wise and round-wise TS EAMCET cutoff lists in the form of PDF from the table below for admission to the B.E. / B.Tech course.

Candidates can view the other specialisation options available for admission at multiple colleges accepting the TS EAMCET entrance exam. The comparison below is based on the last round cutoff rank of TS EAMCET for the General HS category students.

The Jyothishmathi Institute of Technology and Science MBA cutoff 2025 for the General HS category in the last round was 36289. In contrast, the cutoff in 2024 was 35286, and the 2023 cutoff was 27360 for the aforementioned course and category. According to this data, we can say that the competition for MBA has been decreasing in the last 3 years.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Infrastructure is decent, but the overly strict rules are annoying.

review_content.Placements: The highest package they claim is around 8 LPA-10 LPA, but that is very rare. The average package is usually between 3 LPA and 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, and some small start-ups. Core branches like Mechanical and Civil struggle a bit more for campus placements. We are mostly told to learn coding on our own if we want a good job. Internships are not provided by the college, we have to pay for and do them outside or find online internships on our own.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are available, but some systems are old and slow. Wi-Fi is there, but the speed is often very poor. The library is good and quiet for studying. I have friends in the hostel, and they say it is manageable. The rooms are shared by 3-4 people. The biggest complaint is that the food is repetitive and sometimes not very tasty. The water facility is okay. There is a canteen, but it is a bit small.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Decent college with supportive staff and good learning atmosphere.

review_content.Placements: I am from the CSE batch. In our year, around 60 percent of students got placed. The highest package is close to 7–8 LPA, and the average is around 3–4 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra and a few startups visited. Internships were limited, but some students received them through faculty support. Most job roles offered are software trainee, support engineer and testing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our department had good Wi-Fi, functional computer labs, decent classrooms and a helpful library. The campus is calm and clean. Hostel facilities are average but manageable. Rooms are fine, and the mess food was okay, though not very tasty. Sports facilities like cricket, volleyball and indoor games are available. Overall, the infrastructure supported us well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Poor placements and below-average facilities.

content.Placements: The placement situation is weak. Only a small percentage of students actually get placed, and most of the packages are very low. Companies coming here are mostly training or internship-oriented and not real placement offers. Very few students get internships, and those are mostly unpaid. The roles are usually basic support or trainee roles. Seriously, the campus placement culture is negligible, and the students more often rely on off-campus opportunities. The placements are disappointing.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is average and, at times, below average. Computer labs are there, but the machinery is old and runs slowly during peak times. The Wi-Fi network is unreliable for learning. Hostel facilities and food are average, but the rooms are not maintained properly. Mess food is almost monotonous and is neither of very good taste nor quality. The sports and medical facilities are below average. The campus requires enhancement and proper maintenance for the benefit of the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Average college with decent facilities but limited placement opportunities.

content.Placements: I am from B. Tech CSE (the 2023–2027 CSE batch). Placements in our college are average. Around 40–50 percent of students get placed. Packages are mostly low to average. The highest package is around 4–5 LPA (for very few students). The average package is about 2–2.5 LPA, and the lowest package is around 1.5 LPA. The companies that come are mostly service-based and small companies. Internship support from the college is limited, so many students search for internships on their own. The roles offered are mostly trainee or junior-level positions.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is decent but not great. Classrooms are okay. Wi-Fi is available but sometimes slow. Labs are usable, but the systems are not very new. The library is average and sufficient for exam preparation. Hostel facilities are average. Rooms are manageable, but cleanliness can be improved. Mess food is okay, sometimes good and sometimes not. Medical and sports facilities are basic.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure is decent, but the overly strict rules are annoying.

content.Placements: The highest package they claim is around 8 LPA-10 LPA, but that is very rare. The average package is usually between 3 LPA and 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, and some small start-ups. Core branches like Mechanical and Civil struggle a bit more for campus placements. We are mostly told to learn coding on our own if we want a good job. Internships are not provided by the college, we have to pay for and do them outside or find online internships on our own.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are available, but some systems are old and slow. Wi-Fi is there, but the speed is often very poor. The library is good and quiet for studying. I have friends in the hostel, and they say it is manageable. The rooms are shared by 3-4 people. The biggest complaint is that the food is repetitive and sometimes not very tasty. The water facility is okay. There is a canteen, but it is a bit small.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Decent college with supportive staff and good learning atmosphere.

content.Placements: I am from the CSE batch. In our year, around 60 percent of students got placed. The highest package is close to 7–8 LPA, and the average is around 3–4 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra and a few startups visited. Internships were limited, but some students received them through faculty support. Most job roles offered are software trainee, support engineer and testing.
content.Infrastructure: Our department had good Wi-Fi, functional computer labs, decent classrooms and a helpful library. The campus is calm and clean. Hostel facilities are average but manageable. Rooms are fine, and the mess food was okay, though not very tasty. Sports facilities like cricket, volleyball and indoor games are available. Overall, the infrastructure supported us well.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Supportive faculty, good placements, well-maintained campus facilities, and nice environment.

content.Placements: I'm from the 2023-27 CSE batch at Eswar College. Around 80 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 8 LPA, the average is 3.5 LPA, and the lowest is 2.2 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Accenture. Nearly 60 percent of students got internships at IBM, TCS iON, and startups as developers and analysts.
content.Infrastructure: Eswar College has good infrastructure with well-equipped CSE labs, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, and a library. Hostels are clean and comfortable with 24/7 water and power. Mess food is decent and the canteen is hygienic. Medical aid and sports facilities are available and well-maintained.
